Welcome to
Padmanath Gohain Baruah Government Model College is a newly established higher educational institution under the aegis of the Department of Higher Education, Govt. of Assam. The College is affiliated with Dibrugarh University and commenced its functional activities in August 2020. Located approximately 65 km from the District Headquarters of Tinsukia at Dirak-Kakopather, it is recognized as one of the premier institutions in the region for higher education. The college offers Higher Secondary and various undergraduate programs in Arts.
